headline: Audacity 4 is a complete revamp of the 'world's most popular' audio editor
summary: Audacity 4, the popular audio editor, has received a major revamp. The update includes significant promised improvements after a past logo controversy. The new version aims to enhance the overall audio editing experience.

headline: The White House is making arcade games racist
summary: The White House released policy-themed 'arcade' games, some of which are accused of being racist. Games are modeled on copyrighted titles, potentially upsetting original holders. The Tetris Company has already responded negatively to the 'Build the Wall' game.

headline: GoPro says it's still committed 'to your collective stoke'
summary: GoPro CEO Nick Woodman reaffirmed the company's commitment to making cameras. This follows a proposed $285 million acquisition by Starman. Woodman believes the merger will strengthen GoPro's content creation tech development.

headline: Roland is getting into generative AI music with Melody Flip
summary: Roland introduces Melody Flip, its first generative AI music tool. The plug-in offers 250 themed 'Palettes' of musical ideas for DAWs. Users can start with a Palette or use a sample to create new melodies.

headline: 14 Predictions for the September 2026 Nintendo Direct and Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct
summary: IGN's Logan Plant shares 14 predictions for upcoming Nintendo Directs. The predictions cover the September 2026 Nintendo Direct. They also include potential announcements for the Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct.

headline: 'No One Puts Double Fine Out of Business Except for Me' — Tim Schafer Explains How He Kept Double Fine Afloat After Leaving Xbox
summary: Tim Schafer, Double Fine founder, vowed to keep the studio afloat. His comments follow Xbox divesting the studio in a major restructuring. Schafer emphasizes his commitment to the Psychonauts developer.

headline: Wonder Woman Casting Rumors Heat Up as Fans Suspect James Gunn Secretly Picked Adria Arjona for the Role
summary: Rumors suggest Adria Arjona may be cast as the DCU's Wonder Woman. Fans noticed her workout video ahead of the 'Man of Tomorrow' film. Speculation links her to James Gunn's casting decisions for the role.

headline: gamescom Apologizes for Its Initial Response to Thefts, Promises Improved Security Measures
summary: gamescom issued a second apology regarding equipment thefts at its event. The apology addresses criticism over their initial reaction to the incidents. Organizers promised improved security measures for future events.

headline: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
summary: Middlesbrough residents express deep distrust and fear of police. Violence has escalated in the town after a fatal A66 crash. Many locals feel unsafe and are reluctant to contact authorities.

headline: Cleveland police chief proud of force but being 'let down' by funding
summary: Cleveland Police chief Victoria Fuller praises her force's efforts. She states the force is 'let down' by inadequate funding. Fuller suggests a merger into a larger, strategic force for more resources.

headline: How the Lindsay Clancy trial gripped America - and ultimately fell apart
summary: The high-profile Lindsay Clancy murder trial concluded with a mistrial. Jurors were unable to reach a unanimous verdict in the Massachusetts case. The case, involving a US mother, captivated national attention.

headline: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
summary: The UN voted to adopt a new world map reflecting Africa's accurate size. The Togo-sponsored resolution passed with 164 nations in favor. The United States was the only nation to vote against the measure.
